title: Anna Paulina Luna's MK Ultra hearing

tellings.quote: Like he's friends with um uh Anna Pina Luna. Okay. She seems to be an insider. She just yesterday had a big u congressional hearing on MK Ultra.

plain: In 2026 a member of the US Congress named Anna Paulina Luna held a large congressional hearing on MK Ultra, a secret CIA programme of mind-control experiments, according to the writer and skeptic Michael Shermer. Shermer mentions it in passing while debating Jesse Michels, saying the researcher Avi Loeb is friends with Luna, who "seems to be an insider", and that her hearing on MK Ultra took place "just yesterday".
